subject: E-6192: cannot write data directory on macOS
body:
Good morning. My seutp is Tallyboard 1.9.3, macOS 14.7. Starting Monday, the moment I open the app a
dialog rads 'E-6192: cannot write to data directory'.

Since Monday a new endpoint protection suite runs on all PCs. Looking at its log, the data directory
is scanned nonstop.

I've already tried searching the help centre, which changed nothing.

Thanks, Ivan Petrov (Oakline Partners)
